Hemoglobin.description: Oxygen-carrying protein in red blood cells (Low levels indicate Anemia).

WBC.description: Immune cells that fight infection (Elevated in bacterial/viral infections).

Platelet.description: Clotting cells (Critically monitored in Dengue and bleeding disorders).

RBC.description: Red blood cell count supporting tissue oxygenation.

Fasting Glucose.description: Fasting blood sugar level (100–125 indicates Prediabetes; ≥126 indicates Diabetes risk).

Creatinine.description: Kidney filtration waste marker (High values suggest renal stress).

SGPT (ALT).description: Liver enzyme (Elevated in fatty liver, hepatitis, or liver inflammation).

SGOT (AST).description: Enzyme reflecting liver and cardiac tissue health.

Total Cholesterol.description: Total blood cholesterol (High levels increase cardiovascular risk).

Triglycerides.description: Blood lipids associated with metabolic and heart health.
